sections.theory:
Example 9.2

The following observations are collected using a completely randomized design:

Construct an ANOVA table for the data and determine whether there is a difference in the three population means. Use α = 0.01

Solution:

i. H_0:\mu_1=\mu_2=\mu_3

H_1: Not all means are equal

ii. \alpha=0.01

iii. Test statistic to be used is

$F=\frac{MSTr}{MSE}\ \text{with}\ (\nu_1=k-1,\nu_2=n-k)\ \text{d.f}$

iv. Calculation:

n=r_1+r_2+r_3=5+5+4=14

C.F=\frac{T_{..}^2}{n}=\frac{(38)^2}{14}=103.1429

TSS=\sum_{j=1}^{3}\sum_{i=1}^{r_j}x_{ij}^2-C.F=130-103.1429=26.8571

T_rSS=\sum_{j=1}^{3}\frac{T_{.j}^2}{r_j}-C.F

=\left[\frac{T_{.1}^2}{r_1}+\frac{T_{.2}^2}{r_2}+\frac{T_{.3}^2}{r_3}\right]-C.F

حل:

i. H_0:\mu_1=\mu_2=\mu_3

H_1: تمام اوسط برابر نہیں

ii. \alpha=0.01

iii. استعمال ہونے والا جانچ کا شماریہ یہ ہے

$F=\frac{MSTr}{MSE}\ \text{with}\ (\nu_1=k-1,\nu_2=n-k)\ \text{d.f}$

iv. حساب:

n=r_1+r_2+r_3=5+5+4=14

C.F=\frac{T_{..}^2}{n}=\frac{(38)^2}{14}=103.1429

TSS=\sum_{j=1}^{3}\sum_{i=1}^{r_j}x_{ij}^2-C.F=130-103.1429=26.8571

T_rSS=\sum_{j=1}^{3}\frac{T_{.j}^2}{r_j}-C.F

=\left[\frac{T_{.1}^2}{r_1}+\frac{T_{.2}^2}{r_2}+\frac{T_{.3}^2}{r_3}\right]-C.F
